name: @folkshops/events
description: Shared Kafka transport types: the outbox's BusinessEventEnvelope, Debezium's DebeziumChangeEvent, and topic-name constants. Consumed by apps/workers (publisher) and apps/analytics (consumer). See docs/decisions/0009-analytics-outbox-cdc-kafka.md. Ships compiled JS (not raw TS re-exported via package.json `exports`, unlike packages/ui) because its consumers are plain Node processes (tsc + `node dist/index.js`), not a bundler that can transpile a workspace package's TypeScript source directly.
